hero.title: Vidyarthi Bhavan: Savor Timeless Tradition and Authentic South Indian Flavors
hero.subtitle: Since 1943, Vidyarthi Bhavan has been a beloved cornerstone of Bangalore's culinary heritage, where time-honored traditions and authentic vegetarian cuisine unite.

about.title: Our Story & Legacy
about.paragraph1: Vidyarthi Bhavan, a heritage South Indian vegetarian restaurant, started in 1943 as a small student's eatery (from where it gets its name). It has since become an integral part of Bangalore's culinary history, evolving into what it is today: a place where time and tradition have stood still, drawing people from all walks of life.
about.paragraph2: From humble beginnings, Vidyarthi Bhavan has cultivated a cherished legacy, serving generations with unparalleled authentic South Indian vegetarian delights. We remain dedicated to preserving the original flavors, time-honored recipes, and the warm, welcoming atmosphere that has made us a timeless landmark in Bangalore's vibrant culinary scene.
